versioningPolicy.majorFormat: vN (SemVer N.0.0) — Major feature & architecture updates
versioningPolicy.minorFormat: vN.xx (SemVer N.0.x / N.x.0) — Minor fixes, tweaks, and incremental patches
versioningPolicy.upgradeSafety: All installers preserve appId (com.modelsort.studio) for seamless in-place NSIS upgrades and automatically migrate legacy v1 data (%APPDATA%\modelsort-studio) into %APPDATA%\watchpulse\watchpulse-data.json without losing models, tiers, hotkeys, or thumbnails.

releases.summary: Performs a full UI declutter pass across TopNav, Live Monitor (Grid, Watch Wall, and Stage), Rapid Sorter, and Settings while keeping Data Grid integrated inside Rapid Sorter.
releases.dataMigrationNote: In-place UI declutter update over v2.08 — preserves all saved models, playlists/tiers, hotkeys, Recycling Bin items, and thumbnails.

items: Slimmed TopNav down to the three primary navigation tabs (Live Monitor, Rapid Sorter, Kanban Board) without inline shortcut badges or the duplicate Playlists & Tiers header button (still accessible via Settings, Live Monitor sidebar, and Ctrl+T).

Scoped Video Only and Audio On/Muted controls strictly to Watch Wall and Stage (removing them from Watchlist Grid), replaced the full-width Stage Sort Watchlist bar with a compact inline tier selector, and auto-collapsed the left sidebar in Watch Wall mode.

Consolidated Watchlist Grid's column density, Hover Live Preview, schedule syncing, and Re-add All Active controls into an Options menu, made Grid card Wall/Hide/Tier controls reveal on hover, and compacted Watch Wall's column picker.

Decluttered Rapid Sorter by defaulting Quick Edit to closed, condensing Enriched Profile Links to a compact inline link bar, removing the raw URLs reference footer, and updating Settings' Data Grid shortcut label.

releases.summary: Declutters Stage View to focus exclusively on the selected model's stream and integrates quick two-way Data Grid navigation directly inside Rapid Sorter.
releases.dataMigrationNote: In-place UI refinement over v2.07 — preserves all saved models, playlists/tiers, hotkeys, Recycling Bin items, and thumbnails.

changes.category: Stage View Declutter & Rapid Sorter Data Grid Integration
items: Removed Followed Cams, CBExplorer, and CBHours mode tabs and directory scan controls from the Stage View toolbar so Stage focuses cleanly on evaluating a single model's live stream performance.
Added an Open Data Grid button directly inside the top-left of Rapid Sorter's workspace alongside a Rapid Sorter return button in the Data Grid toolbar for seamless two-way switching.

releases.summary: Hardens the 'Usually Live Around Now' prediction algorithm with recency weighting, active-day hit rates, logoff-tail filtering, midnight wrap alignment, and percentage confidence scores, and enforces strict playlist tier priority sorting across both Watchlist Grid and Watch Wall.
releases.dataMigrationNote: In-place patch over v2.06 — preserves all saved models, playlists/tiers, hotkeys, Recycling Bin items, and thumbnails.

items: Rewrote getUsuallyLiveNowMeta to weight recent 14-day sessions, require genuine current/upcoming-hour activity rather than trailing logoff spillover, align overnight hours across midnight to their session day/weekday, reject isolated stale blips via active-day hit rate and weekday routine thresholds, and expose confidence percentages directly on offline grid card badges and tooltips.

Added shared compareMonitorTierPriority sorting across Watchlist Grid cards, Watch Wall tile ordering, Pull Online to Wall, and Re-add All Active so higher playlist tiers (Priority 1, Priority 2, Watchlist, Backlog, Inactive, Inbox) always take precedence over viewer counts within live and offline visibility buckets.

releases.summary: Promotes Live Monitor to WatchPulse's primary startup window and first navigation tab (Ctrl+1), adds CBExplorer historical broadcast activity syncing for accurate 30-day heatmaps & active hours even when WatchPulse was closed, enables Stage audio by default, and puts Playlists & Tiers directly inside Settings.
releases.dataMigrationNote: In-place UI & navigation update over v2.05 — preserves all saved models, tiers, hotkeys, Recycling Bin items, and thumbnails.

changes.category: Primary Window, Stage Audio, Playlist Settings & CBExplorer Activity History
items: Added Usually Live Around Now detection, filter pills (in Live Monitor sidebar and Watchlist Grid), and offline card badges comparing each model's 30-day schedule against your current local hour (+/- 1h), plus a rate-safe Sync Schedules action to pull 90-day CBExplorer history across your watchlist.

Added automatic & one-click CBExplorer broadcast history syncing (livestats/streams) inside ActivityHeatmap (Model Editor & Rapid Sorter Inspector) so 30d Active Time, Avg / Day, Usual Window, Last Seen Live, and the 30-day heatmap populate accurately from CBExplorer's historical session logs even when WatchPulse was closed.
Set Live Monitor (Watchlist Grid / Watch Wall / Stage) as the default landing view when opening WatchPulse.

Moved Live Monitor to the first navigation slot with Ctrl+1, shifting Rapid Sorter to Ctrl+2, Kanban Board to Ctrl+3, and Data Grid to Ctrl+4 across TopNav, global shortcuts, and the Settings shortcut guide.

Split Stage audio from Watch Wall / Hover Preview mute state so Stage defaults to Audio On (both in HLS playback and dynamically stripping disable_sound=1 on WebView fallback embeds) while Watch Wall and grid hover previews remain muted unless unmuted.
Added a direct Playlists & Tiers tab right inside Settings as well as an Edit Watchlists / Playlists & Hotkeys (Ctrl+T) button inside Live Monitor's sidebar header and TopNav.

releases.summary: Comprehensive stability, data-integrity, and UI reliability hardening release fixing 15 stress-tested issues across persistent JSON storage, backup recovery, import/export parsers, HLS live player transitions, Watch Wall stream filtering, Rapid Sorter queue/undo flow, Kanban drag reordering, and Data Grid pagination.
releases.dataMigrationNote: In-place update over v2.04 — preserves all saved models, tiers, hotkeys, notes, heatmaps, and Recycling Bin items, while automatically deduplicating any legacy duplicate usernames/IDs/hotkeys and protecting corrupted backups from being overwritten.

changes.category: Storage Integrity, Backup Safety & App Resilience
items: Fixed permanent write-queue poisoning in JsonStorageService after a transient I/O error by resetting the queue tail on rejection, using unique per-write temp paths, and sweeping orphaned .tmp files on startup.
Prevented corrupted primary storage files from overwriting healthy .bak.json backups and removed backup truncation inside load() repair paths.
Added synchronous window beforeunload flushing (store:saveSync IPC) so fast edits right before app close are persisted to disk.

Hardened sanitizeAppData and sanitizeClientAppData across Electron and renderer to normalize partial settings, reject reserved hotkeys (Z/Space/length > 1), deduplicate IDs/usernames/hotkeys, validate ISO dates and calendar presenceHours, and added a top-level React ErrorBoundary.
Fixed sanitizeUsername on /embed/, /fullvideo/, /lists/, and /in/?room=<handle> URLs.
Fixed single-line CSV/text imports matching header keywords (e.g. 'username') and preserved second/subsequent columns on comma-separated plain handle lines.
Added spreadsheet formula-injection neutralization in CSV exports and preserved leading forward slashes on POSIX file:// thumbnail URIs.

Removed side effects from React setState updaters, added tier/sourceFilter undo restoration, request sequence guarding on live feed polling, duplicate username rejection with immediate notifications, and orphan thumbnail cleanup.

changes.category: Live Monitor, Sorter, Kanban, Grid & Modal UX
items: Fixed Mute/Audio toggles interrupting active HLS playback in LiveStreamPlayer and invalidated stale roomStatus cache entries on show transitions.
Added Public Only vs All Live filtering for Watch Wall pulls plus graceful onError fallback avatars for broken grid thumbnails.
Fixed Rapid Sorter same-tier advancing across All Models/Inbox views, global Undo stack pollution on Sorter Undo, stale skippedIds cleanup, and draft-based Quick-Edit Username committing.

Fixed Kanban drag reordering when filters are active or dragging downward, prevented Escape from closing Tier Manager while recording hotkeys, kept Settings Advanced JSON editor synchronized, prevented duplicate-username saves from closing Model Editor, and paginated Data Grid.

releases.summary: Switches WatchPulse live detection to a zero-config public CDN live index so every Watchlist shows active rooms immediately without any Affiliate wm key, adds a CBExplorer-style Watchlist Grid with auto-refreshing thumbnails and silent hover live previews, extracts pure HLS video-only streams via hls.js for zero-clutter playback, and adds direct CBExplorer list URL importing.
releases.dataMigrationNote: In-place update over v2.03 — preserves all saved models, tiers, hotkeys, notes, heatmaps, and Recycling Bin items, while upgrading untouched Affiliate default feeds without a wm code to the zero-config live feed and updating livePreview defaults with hide_logo=1.

changes.category: Zero-Config Live Detection & CBExplorer-Style Watchlist Grid
items: Switched default live feed to CBExplorer's public CDN live rooms index (cbexplorer_users_online_v3.json) and added columnar + status-bucket decoders so Public, Private, Away, Hidden, viewer counts, and room subjects populate automatically with zero Affiliate wm setup.

Rebuilt Live Monitor's default view as a CBExplorer-style Watchlist Grid filtered by Watchlist/Tier and Public Live / All Online / All Models, featuring 15-second auto-refreshing live cam thumbnails and silent hover live video preview.
Added direct CBExplorer Watchlist URL importing (https://cbexplorer.com/lists/...) inside Import Models to pull entire lists cleanly into WatchPulse watchlists.

changes.category: Pure Embedded Video Stream Playback (HLS Video-Only)
items: Added main-process stream metadata resolution paired with an hls.js HTML5 video player (LiveStreamPlayer) to stream pure video without webpage headers, logos, banners, or chat—backed by automatic WebView CSS isolation fallback.
Preserved unlimited Watch Wall Multiplay with Pull Online Only, per-tile Hide, Hidden Active restore chips, Re-add All Active, and Drop Offline controls without CBExplorer Hub.

releases.summary: Removes the CBExplorer Hub portal tab from Live Monitor, upgrades the Silent Watch Wall to pull all online models without a 6-tile limit plus per-tile Hide and Re-add All Active controls, and isolates only the embedded livestream video player in both Stage and Watch Wall.
releases.dataMigrationNote: In-place update over v2.02 — preserves all WatchPulse models, tiers, hotkeys, Recycling Bin items, and thumbnails, while upgrading untouched legacy livePreview templates to include embed_video_only=1.

items: Removed CBExplorer Hub tab from Live Monitor while keeping Live Stream, Followed Cams (Detect Live), CBExplorer, and CBHours.
Upgraded Watch Wall to pull all currently online models only (removing the 6-tile cap) with responsive column density options (Auto, 2, 3, or 4 columns) and Drop Offline cleanup.
Added per-tile Hide buttons with a collapsible Hidden Active restore tray plus a one-click Re-add All Active button on the Watch Wall toolbar.
Added Video Only stream isolation across Live Stream Stage and Watch Wall tiles via embed_video_only=1 and CSP-safe Electron CSS video-player extraction (with a Video Only toggle pill).

releases.summary: Rebuilds Live Monitor around Only-Live filtering and per-Watchlist grouping, adds Followed Cams and one-click Detect Live from View DOM scanning against saved models, introduces inline Sort Watchlist tier pills and manual Mark Live toggles, and adds client_ip=request_ip plus 25-page fetching to the Affiliate onlinerooms feed.
releases.dataMigrationNote: In-place update over v2.0.1 — preserves all WatchPulse models, tiers, hotkeys, Recycling Bin items, and thumbnails, while upgrading untouched legacy onlinerooms endpoint templates to include client_ip=request_ip.

items: Added an Only Live filter toggle in Live Monitor (auto-activates when live models are present) paired with per-Watchlist/Tier grouping in the collapsible sidebar and horizontal Watchlist filter pills.
Added per-tier live counts and one-click Load to Wall actions so an entire live watchlist tier can be opened on the Multi-Tile Silent Watch Wall together.
Added inline Sort Watchlist tier pills, Next navigation, and manual Mark Live toggles directly above the blended Live Monitor stage.

Added a Followed Cams source tab alongside CBExplorer Hub in Live Monitor plus a user-triggered Detect Live from View read-only DOM scan that matches visible rooms strictly against saved watchlist models.

Updated the default Chaturbate Affiliate onlinerooms template to include client_ip=request_ip, automatically migrating untouched default templates in existing configs, and raised Affiliate pagination support up to 25 pages (default 5).

releases.summary: Replaces the popup live-preview modal with a seamlessly blended in-app Live Stage and Multi-Tile Silent Watch Wall inside Live Monitor, removes unused API feed warning banners, and adds optional Authorization header support for custom/Statbate JSON feeds.
releases.dataMigrationNote: In-place update over v2.0.0 — preserves all WatchPulse models, tiers, hotkeys, Recycling Bin items, and thumbnails.

changes.category: Seamless Embedded Live Stage & Watch Wall
items: Replaced SilentPreviewModal popup with a blended SeamlessWebView stage directly inside Live Monitor (zero URL bars, zero popup windows, zero external browser chrome, muted by default).
Added a Watchlist sidebar rail and Multi-Tile Silent Watch Wall (pin up to 6 models side-by-side or load an entire filtered tier with 1 click).
Clicking Silent View from Rapid Sorter, Kanban, or Data Grid now switches smoothly into the blended Live Monitor Stage with a Back button.
Removed intrusive warning banners when no Affiliate wm feed is configured and added an optional Authorization header field in Settings for custom or Statbate Plus JSON feeds.

releases.summary: Rebrands ModelSort Studio to WatchPulse with a new Radar/Tier icon, and introduces Live Monitor with Silent Live View, periodic tier re-sort workflows, local 7x24 activity heatmaps, a defined 45-day Recycling Bin lifecycle, under-the-hood settings, and username underscore preservation.
releases.dataMigrationNote: Automatically migrates v1 ModelSort Studio data (%APPDATA%\modelsort-studio\modelsort-data.json and thumbnails) into WatchPulse (%APPDATA%\watchpulse\watchpulse-data.json) and upgrades schemas to v2 in place (repairing stripped leading/trailing underscores or hyphens while preserving all existing records).

items: Preserved leading and trailing underscores and hyphens in sanitizeUsername (e.g., _bamby_baby_ and yvie_ now stay intact across display handles, clean usernames, and automated CBHours/CBExplorer/ArchiveBate URLs).
Added one-time v1-to-v2 data repair on startup to restore stripped edge underscores/hyphens from originalLink or displayName on existing saved models.
Added Live Monitor view displaying online/public/private/offline totals, per-tier live breakdowns, viewer counts, HD indicators, room topics, and Last Seen Live timestamps.

Added Silent Live View modal using an isolated Electron webview muted by default at the Chromium main-process level, with Live Stream Embed, CBExplorer, and CBHours Stats tabs plus an audio mute/unmute toggle.
Added CORS-free JSON live-feed polling via Electron main process IPC (live:fetchJson).
Tracked lastReviewedAt and lastSeenLiveAt timestamps per model with configurable per-tier and global review cadence days plus stale offline thresholds.
Added Due for Re-sort queue filter and Confirm & Keep hotkey behavior in Rapid Sorter (pressing the current tier hotkey marks a model reviewed and advances).
Added local 30-day presence logging (presenceHours) and a 7x24 Usually Active Heatmap in Model Editor alongside optional CBHours pinned stats fields.
Added Add & Add Another workflow and Recycling Bin duplicate detection with 1-click restore in Import / Add Modal.
Replaced native browser confirm() prompts with a dark-themed in-app Delete Confirmation Modal offering Move to Recycling Bin or Move to Inactive tier.

Added a 45-day Recycling Bin modal accessible from the top navigation bar with remaining-days countdown, 1-click Restore, manual Purge, Empty Bin, automatic startup expiry purge, and disk cleanup for orphaned local thumbnails.
Rebranded application from ModelSort Studio to WatchPulse with a custom Watchlist Radar Eye + Priority Tier Bars emblem across window titlebars, top navigation, and Windows .ico/.png icons.
Added automatic first-run migration from legacy %APPDATA%\modelsort-studio data and thumbnails into %APPDATA%\watchpulse.
Expanded Settings into 4 tabs: General & Shortcuts, Live Monitor & Re-Sort, URL Templates, and Under the Hood.

Exposed editable {username} URL templates, Affiliate wm and API endpoint templates, Test Feed Connection diagnostics, batch Re-sanitize Usernames, Mark All Reviewed Today, and an interactive Internal JSON Tweaker.
Configured update-in-place NSIS installer behavior (deleteAppDataOnUninstall: false) and automated CHANGELOG.docx generation.

releases.summary: First standalone Windows release of ModelSort Studio built with Electron, Vite, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
releases.dataMigrationNote: Initializes local atomic JSON persistence (modelsort-data.json + modelsort-data.bak.json) in %APPDATA%\modelsort-studio.

items: Dynamic Tier & Category Manager with add, rename, drag/arrow reorder, color coding, custom hotkey recording, safe deletion reassignment, and customizable Unsorted / Inbox state.
CSV/TSV and clipboard ingestion with PapaParse, regex username sanitization, duplicate handling, and automated CBHours, CBExplorer, and ArchiveBate link generation.

Three synchronized working views: Rapid Sorter (hotkey deck, Space skip, Z/Backspace undo, Quick-Edit inspector), Drag-and-Drop Kanban Board, and searchable/filterable Master Data Grid with bulk operations.
Card media customization (image URL or copied local thumbnail served via local-media://), custom recording links, tags, and activity notes.
Export Studio for enriched CSV, formatted JSON backup, and tier-grouped plain-text summaries, packaged as Windows Portable and NSIS Setup executables.
